verdict.rationale: Zep's own open-source Graphiti framework is documented as building and querying a Context Graph "locally". The main Zep product, however, installs as `zep-cloud`, and its deployment options are listed only as Cloud or the customer's VPC. Nothing in the pack shows local or embedded LLM and embedding models, or a fully offline setup with no cloud dependency. Missing for 10: documented local or self-hosted model support (e.g. local LLMs and embedders), an explicit no-cloud or offline guarantee, an embedded in-process mode for the core Zep memory layer, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the memory layer fully locally — embedded in-process or against local models — without any cloud dependency

citations.quote: Graphiti is the open-source temporal knowledge graph framework. Use it to build and query a single Context Graph per subject locally
